text:
Lina - Marketing: Heads-up : launching a 'Plugins & Integrations' tutorial series aimed at community contributors and platform integrators. Deliverables: one long-form tutorial + short announcement post + 30m live office-hours (hands-on). Need routing and copy. Timeline: ship assets by next Tue.
Omar - DevRel: I'll own the tutorial repo and the hands-on lab. Plan: 20m guided walkthrough building a tiny plugin that calls Redwood API + 10m Q&A. Repo will include a CONTRIBUTING.md and a tiny test harness.
Priya - Product: Bench angle optional here; instead include a short section on "production considerations" (model pinning, autoscale hints, minimal batching config). Keep it practical.
Zoe - Growth Ops: Routing plan: plugin_signups -> self-serve community list + repo invite; contrib_interest -> tag 'contributor' and route to community slack invite flow. Hidden form fields: github_handle, primary_language, expected_monthly_requests. If expected_monthly_requests>100k -> flag sales_alert.
Nico - Community: To encourage PRs, include a small bounty pool for first 10 merged community PRs (swag + early access). We'll mention mentorship hours during office-hours. Also prepare a short contributor checklist.
Lina - Marketing: Draft hero blurb: "Plugins & Integrations: build a working Redwood plugin in one session — code, tests, and a path to contribute. Free hands-on lab and office hours." Channels: blog, dev.to, twitter, and show-hn for the repo. Short social copy: ":wrench: Build a Redwood plugin in 30m — code first tutorial + office-hours: https://go.redwood/plugins?utm_campaign=plugin_series&utm_content=announceA"
Omar - DevRel: Repo layout: `/plugin/README.md`, `/examples/`, `/tests/`, `/contrib/mentorship.md`. I'll include a small CI workflow that runs the plugin with a mocked runtime so people can validate locally.
Priya - Product: Add a 1-paragraph "when to use" and a tiny config snippet showing pinning and batch config: 
```yaml
model: open-13b-q4f16
batching: max_tokens:1024, max_batch_size:8
```
Lina - Marketing: Email variants: (A) "Contribute: build a Redwood plugin in 30m" (B) "Join office-hours: ship a plugin + get PR help". CTA mapping: plugin_repo -> self-serve; contributor_interest -> route to community mentor queue.
Zoe - Growth Ops: I'll implement tags and the hidden fields in the form. Also add `utm_content` to track creative and `promo=plugin-swag` param for the bounty cohort. Will auto-add contributor leads to a mailing list and create a Trello card for flagged enterprise signals.
Nico - Community: We'll run two office-hours slots (EMEA/APAC and Americas). Will post a short onboarding thread in community channel with pinned resources and a tiny feedback form after session (1-2 Qs).
announce-bot: Reminder: planning check in 48h. RSVP: Lina, Omar, Priya, Zoe, Nico.
Lina - Marketing: Owners & deadlines: Omar -> repo + CI (72h), Priya -> product blurb + config snippet (48h), Zoe -> routing + tracking (24h), Nico -> office-hours schedule + mentorship plan (48h), Lina -> blog + social calendar (48h). I'll open GH issues and shared doc now: https://go.redwood/marketing/plugins-series-draft. Thanks all :sparkles:
